meta.name: genomic-coordinates
meta.description: Convert genomic intervals between coordinate conventions, normalise and compare variant representations, and detect assembly or contig-naming mismatches before they corrupt an analysis. Use whenever coordinates cross a format, tool, or assembly boundary - converting between BED, GFF/GTF, VCF, SAM/BAM, WIG, PSL, genePred, Picard interval_list, or region strings; reconciling 0-based half-open with 1-based inclusive; left-aligning or trimming indels; checking whether two variant records describe the same change; mapping genomic to transcript, CDS, or protein positions; auditing a BED/GTF/VCF for convention violations; or diagnosing GRCh37 vs hg19 vs GRCh38 vs T2T, chr-prefix, and liftover problems. Triggers include "off by one", "0-based", "1-based", "half-open", "coordinate system", "left-align", "normalize variant", "bcftools norm", "chr prefix", "wrong genome build", "liftover", "REF mismatch", and "HGVS".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能帮你处理基因组位置信息:在 BED、GFF、VCF 等格式间转换坐标写法,标准化和比较变异记录,检查参考基因组版本是否匹配,并审计文件格式错误。
howto.when: 当坐标处理涉及格式、工具或基因组版本之间的转换时触发,例如提到“off by one”、“0-based”、“1-based”等术语,或要求转换 BED、GFF、VCF 等格式、标准化变异、检查 contig 命名时。

say.text: 用 ref.fa 标准化变异 chr1:7:CAC:C
say.note: 将变异左对齐并检查 REF 是否匹配参考基因组。

say.text: 检查 variants.vcf 和 annotation.gtf 的基因组版本

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to handle genomic positions: convert coordinates between BED/GFF/VCF, normalise and compare variants, detect assembly or contig-naming mismatches, and audit interval files for convention violations.
howto.when_en: Triggers when coordinates cross format/tool/assembly boundaries - e.g. mention 'off by one', '0-based', '1-based', or ask to convert coordinate formats, normalise variants, or check contig naming.

say_en.text: Convert this BED coordinate to GFF: chr1 999 1000
say_en.note: Runs the coordinate converter and shows the result.
Left-aligns the variant and checks REF against the reference.

say_en.text: Check whether variants.vcf and annotation.gtf share a genome build
say_en.note: Runs the contig checker and reports naming or length mismatches.
